issues.description: The visibility of the Person.firstName field differs between template and solution: the template declares firstName as private while the solution declares it public. This inconsistency is likely accidental and may confuse students about the intended visibility and encapsulation of the Person fields (getters/setters are provided in both versions).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across template and solution. Preferably keep the field private (as in the template) and access it via the existing getter/setter methods; update the solution's Person.firstName declaration to be private to preserve encapsulation and avoid confusing students.
